story.title: Your peaceful escape among the trees
story.first: Kookh Al Soroor began with a simple dream: to create a peaceful retreat in nature that brings luxury and simplicity together. In 2023, we began building the cabin in the heart of Wadi Al Soroor, surrounded by old trees and towering mountains.
story.second: Every detail was thoughtfully designed to give our guests an exceptional experience, from handcrafted wooden furniture to large windows overlooking beautiful natural scenery.
story.imageAlt: Kookh Al Soroor surrounded by nature

cancellation.question: What is the cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: Cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before arrival. After that, one night will be charged.

times.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
times.answer: Check-in starts at 3:00 PM and check-out is before 12:00 PM.

pets.question: Are pets allowed?
pets.answer: Pets are not allowed inside the cabin.

smoking.question: Is smoking allowed?
smoking.answer: Smoking is not allowed inside the cabin. It is permitted only on the outdoor terrace.

children.question: Is the cabin suitable for children?
children.answer: Children are welcome, and an extra bed is available upon request.

methods.question: Which payment methods are available?
methods.answer: We accept credit cards, Apple Pay and STC Pay, in addition to payment upon arrival.

secure.question: Is payment secure?
secure.answer: Yes. All payments are processed through secure and encrypted payment gateways.

refund.question: What is the refund policy?
refund.answer: Refunds are issued according to the cancellation policy and the payment method used.

chargeTime.question: When will I be charged?
chargeTime.answer: The payment date and amount are shown clearly before you confirm the booking.
